scientific_question: Are independently derived Altair A549 and Myllia A549 same-target perturbation directions reproducible enough to justify a later held-context donor experiment?

source_representation.myllia: median replicated-guide target effect in log1p TS50000 pseudobulk coordinates
source_representation.rationale: The question concerns source-native perturbation directions. Cosine removes row magnitude but no outcome-dependent or source-fitted coordinate transform is allowed.

target_axis.construction: exact UTF-8 string intersection of the two frozen perturbation text axes

response_axis.complete_case_rule: one global mask requiring measured finite support in every selected target row from both sources
response_axis.excluded_coordinates: union of all 300 VCC panel response coordinates and all 20 common target-gene response coordinates

primary_metric.name: bidirectional_own_target_cosine_retrieval_pds
primary_metric.cosine: float64 uncentered cosine over the single frozen response mask
primary_metric.ties: exact float64 ties receive arithmetic midrank
primary_metric.zero_row: if predictor row or its assigned own-target reference row has zero L2 norm, assign PDS 0.5
primary_metric.macro: equal arithmetic mean of the two directional PDS values

own_target_cosine.definition: cosine between exact same-target source rows over the frozen response mask

top20_predictor_magnitude_sign_precision.selection: max(1, ceil(0.20 times response coordinate count)) coordinates per target
top20_predictor_magnitude_sign_precision.ranking: descending absolute predictor magnitude with canonical gene index ascending as exact tie break
top20_predictor_magnitude_sign_precision.correct: both signs nonzero and exactly equal

target_label_derangement_null.generation: rejection sample numpy permutation until every position differs from identity
target_label_derangement_null.assignment: a frozen derangement maps each Altair label to a Myllia row; the inverse map is used for Myllia to Altair so each replicate represents one bijective cross-source relabeling
target_label_derangement_null.p_value: (1 + count(null macro PDS >= observed macro PDS)) / 10001

whole_target_bootstrap.resampling: sample 20 target indices with replacement; use the same sampled target multiplicities in both directions
whole_target_bootstrap.statistic: equal macro of the two resampled directional mean PDS values
whole_target_bootstrap.confidence_interval: numpy quantile method linear at 0.025 and 0.975
